blocks.text: Secure, resilient, scalable, and run by the people who built it

Purview designs, installs and supports enterprise network infrastructure for new buildings, refreshes, security upgrades and large-scale transformation. Because the same group installs the cabling beneath the network and the GPU floors above it, you get one accountable owner from the outlet to the core, and a 24×7 operation behind it.
